tilts.set: SET on 2026-11-06 by the Portfolio Fitness for Fighting judg

industry.why: Neutral at industry level, carried, with the sector rows carrying the view: Utilities integrated moves to Overweight this week on the first European power-price reading in a month (Nordic power forwards up, Fortum's 22-year nuclear agreement with Google; Danske Bank, 28 October), Regulated networks stays Neutral and Renewable generators stays Underweight because the ten-year above 5% is the row's discount rate. Component 1 regime, 30-Oct-26 (risk-off beneath a steady index, led now by credit and the cost of debt rather than by the artificial intelligence wash-out alone: the US ten-year above 5% after a hawkish Fed hold with two dissents for a hike, Goldman Sachs' Risk Appetite Indicator at its lowest since April 2025, euro investment-grade and high-yield yields up 30 and 90 basis points since September, Brent near $115, the French premium a record 150 basis points, Europe rotating to quality, defensives and non-AI growth, the STOXX Europe 600 1.7% from its high with breadth recovering from the bottom fifth of three years and defensives leading cyclicals at four weeks and three months; sources present 2026-W44). Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-10-30 against 2026-08-28, not week on week: D now, D prior, DISAGREES with the sector move; rate-sensitives lagged on the week (Outset Global). Counter-case for B: pricing-power defensives are the rotation's destination; for D: the tape. Moves to B if a second power-price reading arrives with the industry's relative strength leaving D.

sector.why: Overweight, carried; the condition for A (a second power-price reading with relative strength leaving D) is half met: Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-11-06 against 2026-09-04, not week on week: C now, C prior, so relative strength has left D, but no power-price reading reached this pack; the condition back to C (Nordic forwards falling back) is untested. Component 1 regime, 6-Nov-26 (risk-off beneath an index at its high, now present in Europe's own prices: the STOXX Europe 600 0.9% from its 52-week high with the share of stocks above the 100, 150 and 200-day averages at or below the tenth percentile of near-high days since 2006, defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows, breadth recovering for a second week; the causes, inflation, rates, yields, credit and the consumer, unread this week because the strategist and newsletter files did not reach the pack, so the credit-and-cost-of-debt read of 30-Oct-26 with the US ten-year above 5% is held one week stale; sources present 2026-W45, headline-only). PGE is second on the starting score this week and no longer marked leaving the Pool. Counter-case: one house, one deal, and the ten-year is the row's discount rate. To A on a second power-price reading; back to C if Nordic forwards are read lower or relative strength falls to F.

geography.why: Neutral, from Overweight. Component 1 regime, 9-Oct-26 (late-cycle rates squeeze turning into a European credit-and-sovereign stress episode: hiking path re-marked up, credit joined rates, French spread 152 basis points, European breadth at three-year lows on all four averages, index 5.3% off its high, defensives turning over one and four weeks but unconfirmed, growth firm at the level; sources present 2026-W41): the condition written on this row on 2-Oct-26 (it stays B only while the Banks row is Overweight) is no longer met, since Banks goes to Neutral on the credit tripwire; the Greek listings in the MI Pool are six banks plus Cenergy, HELLENiQ Energy and Motor Oil, with the live holding Ballys Intralot beside them, so the country letter was a second bank weight, and in a week when European sovereign stress is spreading from France to Italy and Spain a bank-heavy periphery listing is where contagion lands next, though Greek spreads themselves were not read. Relative strength is not graded by country. Counter-case: Goldman Sachs's emerging market team (8 Oct) stays overweight Greece by name, Greece is not among the sovereigns named under stress, and the Greek energy names are on the right side of the regime; back to B if the Banks row returns to Overweight.

defs.atr: average true range: each day's high to low, stretched to the previous close on a gap, as a % of the previous close; L5D the last 5 sessions, L1M and L3M the last 30 and 91 calendar days
defs.top_half: a close above the midpoint of the day's high-low range; an up day closes at or above the previous close; days with no range are left out
